title: Students
help: Add students, correct names and gender, archive leavers, restore students or remove unused records.

title: Staff reporting directory
help: These staff choices are used in reporting. Staff are separate from student allocations.

title: Sponsors
help: Maintain sponsor contact details. Link sponsors to students separately.

title: Student sponsor links
help: Choose the exact student, term and sponsor.

title: Student class corrections
help: Correct a student class for a specific academic year.

title: Student support and bed rest
help: Sensitive support records. Clinical notes remain restricted to authorised staff.

title: Accommodation allocations
help: Enter a hostel or building, room and bed. Use the normal accommodation screen for daily work.

title: Immigration profiles
help: Correct immigration details here. Upload files through the Immigration document tool.

title: Student leadership appointments
help: Appoint or retire leadership roles. Choose an exact active student.

title: Prefect duty weeks
help: Create or correct the Prefect and Senior Prefect on Duty for a Monday beginning week.

title: Bell kitchen and toilet duty weeks
help: Create the duty week first, then add its kitchen and toilet duty members. Removing a week also removes its own duty members.

title: Kitchen and toilet duty members
help: Add up to four students per duty, with no more than two men and two women. Remove an individual assignment here.

title: Night gate duty assignments
help: Create or correct one student per night gate slot. Your IT identity and name are recorded automatically.

title: Department student members
help: Assign students and HODs to departments. Use end dates or archive to retain history.

title: Department directory
help: Maintain names and reporting sections. Set a new department PIN separately in PIN access.

title: Work session timetable
help: Enter session times. The end time must be later than the start time.

title: Department reporting units
help: Enter units used by activity and reporting records.

title: Reporting figure definitions
help: Define reporting figures and how period reports aggregate them.

title: Department cohort totals
help: Correct standing cohort totals only after reviewing membership.

title: Standing work schedules
help: Choose the days and sessions when a department is always on.

title: Department plans
help: Create and correct daily or weekly plans.

title: Department stock catalogue
help: Configure stock names and minimum levels. IT assets have their own register.

title: Department stock movements
help: Record receipts as positive amounts and usage as negative amounts.

title: Department activity logs
help: Enter operational quantities and notes.

title: Reporting activity records
help: Enter activity data through named form fields.

title: Work tasks
help: Use work submission for normal scheduling. IT can correct or cancel records here.

title: Work requests
help: Correct work requests after reviewing their linked sessions.

title: Tasks attached to requests
help: Attach an existing task to an existing request.

title: Published work sessions
help: Correct existing published sessions. Conference Mode still enforces server rules.

title: Tasks attached to sessions
help: Maintain task links and order within sessions.

title: Named session assignments
help: Correct named assignments. Normal leadership allocation uses cohort totals.

title: Session cohort allocations
help: Correct cohort totals assigned to a published session.

title: Session department members
help: Maintain the department members attached to a published session.

title: Department reports
help: Correct report content. Report approval transitions remain in the normal reporting screen.

title: Report figures
help: Enter targets, actual figures and explanatory notes.

title: Management follow up actions
help: Maintain follow up work and its owner.

title: Transfers between departments
help: Correct the transfer header after checking the receiving department.

title: Transfer items
help: Enter the items and quantities attached to a transfer.

title: Student fee records
help: Enter fee and notice information manually. This form never sends a notice.

title: Academic terms
help: Maintain term names fee deadlines and form field definitions. Open or close enrolment using Term enrolment.

title: Meal collection records
help: Correct an individual collection record. Conference rules remain enforced.

title: Advance meal check in records
help: Correct preparation check in records separately from meal collection.

title: Campus movements
help: Correct campus movement records. Choose the actual direction and time.

title: Gate pass records
help: Correct pass details. Use the approval screens for decisions and returns.

title: Group gate pass members
help: Maintain group membership after checking the whole pass.

title: Gate terminal devices
help: Create an authorised gate device here and use its pairing token on the terminal. Existing device tokens can be replaced through the protected form.

title: Gate duty attendance records
help: Correct or remove an individual duty attendance record after reviewing the scan time.

title: Library titles
help: Enter book details manually or use ISBN lookup in Library.

title: Library physical copies
help: Correct copy details and condition. Use normal checkout and return for circulation.

title: Operations configuration
help: Maintain approved operations settings. Choose a value type and enter the value through the form.

title: Library configuration
help: Maintain library loan rules and catalogue visibility. Daily rule changes can also be made in Library settings.

title: Enrolment corrections
help: Reopen a completed enrolment before correcting it. Use the labelled student fields for reviewed corrections, including older terms. Staff sections are completed in Administration Staff. Existing submissions and change history are retained.
